name: gkill_autolog
description: PC・Android端末・Chromeから客観的な操作ログを自動収集し、gkillへ記録する

scripts.go_mod: rimraf src/autolog/go.mod && rimraf src/autolog/go.sum && cd src/autolog && go mod init github.com/mt3hr/gkill_autolog/src/autolog && go mod tidy
scripts.vet_android: cross-env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 npm run vet
scripts.build_windows_amd64: cross-env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 node src/tools/build_go.mjs windows_amd64 autolog.exe
scripts.build_linux_amd64: cross-env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 node src/tools/build_go.mjs linux_amd64 autolog
scripts.build_linux_arm64: cross-env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 node src/tools/build_go.mjs linux_arm64 autolog
scripts.build_linux_arm: cross-env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm node src/tools/build_go.mjs linux_arm autolog
scripts.build_android_arm64: cross-env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=android GOARCH=arm64 node src/tools/build_go.mjs android_arm64 autolog
scripts.build_go_parallel: run-p build_windows_amd64 build_linux_amd64 build_linux_arm64 build_linux_arm build_android_arm64
scripts.build_x_compile: npm run build_go_parallel && npm run build_android_apk
scripts.release: npm run clean_release && npm run build_x_compile && npm run verify_release_artifacts
scripts.test: npm run test_go && npm run test_chrome_ext
